name: semver_tools
description: Parse, compare, sort and bump Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 versions and match them against npm (node-semver) ranges. Precedence follows the SemVer spec (numeric before alphanumeric prerelease identifiers, build metadata ignored); ranges accept comparators, ^ caret, ~ tilde, x-ranges, partial versions, hyphen ranges and ||, with node-semver's desugaring (shown) and its prerelease rule, and report which versions satisfy plus the highest and lowest match.

preid.description: Prerelease identifier for pre* bumps, e.g. beta

include_prerelease.description: Let prereleases match like normal versions; match

catalog.source: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 (semver.org), section 11 precedence; range grammar, desugaring, prerelease rule and inc() behaviour of npm's node-semver (README and classes/range.js, semver.js)
